### Chart Overview
This is a stacked bar chart titled **Debt by Instruments (percent of GDP)** (based on the context of the full document). It illustrates the projected decline of two types of debt from 2023 through 2029.

*   **Y-Axis:** Represents the percentage of GDP, ranging from 0 to 180 in increments of 20.
*   **X-Axis:** Represents the years from 2023 to 2029.
*   **Legend:**
    *   **Blue bars:** Marketable debt
    *   **Orange bars:** Nonmarketable debt
*   **Projection Line:** A solid black horizontal line labeled "**Proj.**" spans from 2024 to 2029 at approximately the 168 level on the Y-axis.

### Data Extraction
The values below are estimated based on the visual height of the stacked bars relative to the Y-axis scale.

| Year | Marketable debt (Blue) | Nonmarketable debt (Orange) | Total Debt (% of GDP) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **2023** | ~84 | ~73 | **~157** |
| **2024** | ~46 | ~34 | **~80** |
| **2025** | ~43 | ~35 | **~78** |
| **2026** | ~38 | ~31 | **~69** |
| **2027** | ~33 | ~27 | **~60** |
| **2028** | ~29 | ~25 | **~54** |
| **2029** | ~25 | ~24 | **~49** |

### Key Observations
*   **Downward Trend:** There is a significant projected decrease in total debt as a percentage of GDP between 2023 and 2029, dropping from approximately 157% to 49%.
*   **Debt Composition:** In 2023, marketable debt and nonmarketable debt are relatively close in value. By 2029, while both have decreased, they remain nearly equal in their smaller proportions.
*   **Significant Drop:** The largest single-year decrease occurs between 2023 and 2024.
